This is a classic exercise from introductory Python courses. In this standard convention, Sunday is mapped to 0, Monday to 1, and so on up to Saturday as 6. 

Here is the best approach using a list and returning the index of the provided day name. If an invalid string is provided, it safely returns `None`.

Confidence level: 100%

```python
def day_number(day_name):
    days = [
        "Sunday", 
        "Monday", 
        "Tuesday", 
        "Wednesday", 
        "Thursday", 
        "Friday", 
        "Saturday"
    ]
    
    if day_name in days:
        return days.index(day_name)
    return None
```
